purpose: Reviewed, low-frequency discovery knowledge for Plan AI. Executable coverage remains limited to dataset entries marked available and registered by the runtime.

providers.catalog_summary: Global macroeconomic and financial statistics covering national accounts, prices, fiscal, external, monetary and financial-sector topics, plus IMF staff forecasts.

datasets.title: Consumer Price Index
datasets.description: Consumer-price index levels by economy and COICOP 1999 category. Inflation rates require a reviewed growth transformation unless a rate series is selected elsewhere.
datasets.geographic_coverage: Explicit IMF economy codes; no implicit aggregate substitution.
datasets.temporal_coverage: Provider-dependent by economy and series; each request is limited to 20 years.
datasets.publication_cadence: Mostly monthly source-country releases; availability and revisions vary by economy. Current structural metadata is checked at acquisition.

indicators.label: All-items CPI index
indicators.notes: Use yoy_growth to derive year-on-year inflation from monthly index levels.

indicators.label: Food and non-alcoholic beverages CPI index

constraints: Explicit economies, COICOP codes, frequency and dates are required.
The current connector retrieves index levels only.
No arbitrary IMF dataflow is executable.

datasets.title: World Economic Outlook
datasets.description: Annual historical estimates and IMF staff projections for major macroeconomic concepts.
datasets.geographic_coverage: IMF member economies and selected groups; executable plans require explicit reviewed economy codes.
datasets.temporal_coverage: Generally 1980 onward with medium-term projections, subject to economy/indicator availability; each request is limited to 50 years.
datasets.publication_cadence: Database editions are normally published twice yearly, in April and October; revisions may occur within an edition.

indicators.label: Consumer prices, average annual percent change
Gross debt, General government, Percent of GDP
indicators.notes: WEO staff estimates and projections may differ from national fiscal statistics; confirm general-government coverage.

indicators.label: Gross debt, General government, Domestic currency
indicators.notes: Preserve the WEO scale and currency context; do not compare levels across economies without a reviewed conversion.

constraints: Annual frequency only.
WEO estimates and forecasts can differ from national statistical sources.
Exact indicator and economy codes are validated at acquisition.

providers.catalog_summary: Global development indicators spanning economy, population, poverty, health, education, environment, infrastructure and institutions.
catalog_examples_not_executable: World Bank sources other than WDI source 2

datasets.title: World Development Indicators
datasets.description: Cross-country development indicators from officially recognized international sources, exposed through the World Bank Indicators API.
datasets.geographic_coverage: Explicit ISO3 economies supported by WDI; World Bank regions and income aggregates are not executable in this slice.
datasets.temporal_coverage: Indicator-dependent; the connector permits a reviewed range of at most 50 years.
datasets.publication_cadence: Observation frequency is annual. Provider updates and historical revisions vary by underlying source; lastupdated is verified on every acquisition.

indicators.label: Inflation, consumer prices (annual %)
indicators.notes: Already a rate; do not apply yoy_growth.

constraints: Only source 2 (WDI) is executable.
Official indicator codes must be verified through provider metadata.
Explicit ISO3 economies and annual dates are required.

providers.provider_name: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
providers.catalog_summary: Comparative statistics for OECD members and partner economies across economic activity, labor, prices, trade, finance, taxation, society and environment.

datasets.title: Composite Leading Indicators
datasets.description: Monthly composite indicators designed to provide early signals of turning points in economic activity relative to trend.
datasets.geographic_coverage: Explicit three-letter OECD reference-area codes available in the pinned dataflow.
datasets.temporal_coverage: Provider-dependent by reference area; the connector permits at most 50 years.

indicators.label: Composite leading indicator
indicators.notes: Not a GDP level or forecast.

constraints: Monthly LI only.
Pinned dataflow and DSD version 4.1.
Explicit reference areas and dates are required.

providers.catalog_summary: Official European statistics covering economy and finance, population, labor, living conditions, industry, trade, agriculture, environment, energy, regions and government.

datasets.title: Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices — monthly index
datasets.description: Comparable monthly all-items consumer-price index for EU and selected European economies using ECOICOP version 2.
datasets.geographic_coverage: Reviewed EU/EFTA country ISO3 mappings; aggregates and unreviewed countries are excluded.
datasets.temporal_coverage: Provider-dependent complete series in the current ECOICOP v2 table; the connector permits at most 50 years.
datasets.publication_cadence: HICP is released monthly. Eurostat checks for dataset and structural updates twice daily and exposes only the latest version.

indicators.label: All-items HICP
indicators.notes: Use yoy_growth when an annual inflation rate is required.

constraints: Monthly all-items index only.
Current ECOICOP v2 classification and 2025=100 unit only.
No aggregates or other HICP measures are executable.

providers.catalog_summary: Asia-Pacific macroeconomic, social, financial, environmental and Sustainable Development Goal indicators assembled from member economies and international sources.

datasets.title: Key Indicators National Accounts
datasets.description: Annual current-local-currency GDP and gross value added for reviewed ADB member-economy mappings.
datasets.geographic_coverage: Reviewed ISO3-to-ADB economy-code mappings for Asia-Pacific members and selected comparator economies.
datasets.temporal_coverage: 2000 through 2024 under the current API contract.
datasets.publication_cadence: KIDB is updated biannually; the admitted national-accounts observations are annual.

indicators.label: Gross domestic product, current local currency
indicators.unit_or_measure: Current local currency with explicit unit multiplier

indicators.label: Gross value added, current local currency
indicators.unit_or_measure: Current local currency with explicit unit multiplier

constraints: Annual frequency and 2000–2024 only.
Only DF_NA 1.0 and the two listed indicators are executable.
Provider economy codes are resolved through a reviewed crosswalk.

providers.catalog_summary: Euro area monetary, banking, financial-market, payments, prices and exchange-rate statistics published through the ECB Data Portal.

datasets.title: Euro foreign exchange reference rates — monthly averages
datasets.description: Monthly averages of ECB euro reference exchange rates, quoted as units of foreign currency per euro.
datasets.geographic_coverage: Reviewed non-euro economy ISO3-to-currency mappings; euro-area country requests are not represented as EUR/EUR rates.
datasets.temporal_coverage: Provider-dependent by currency; each request is limited to 50 years.
datasets.publication_cadence: Reference rates are published on TARGET working days around 16:00 CET; this slice uses provider-computed monthly averages.

indicators.label: Euro foreign-exchange reference rate, monthly average
indicators.notes: Direction is foreign currency per EUR; invert only through a reviewed transformation.

constraints: Pinned EXR 1.0 dimensions M.CURRENCY.EUR.SP00.A.
Monthly averages and explicit periods only.
History is excluded from the main response and revision status is preserved separately.

providers.catalog_summary: International banking, securities, derivatives, property-price, credit, debt-service, liquidity, exchange-rate and central-bank statistics.

datasets.title: Central bank policy rates
datasets.description: Long monthly end-of-period policy-rate series selected with national central banks for advanced and emerging-market economies.
datasets.geographic_coverage: Reviewed ISO3-to-BIS reference-area mappings with an exact availability check before retrieval.
datasets.temporal_coverage: Series-dependent, with several economies extending to 1946; requests are limited to 100 years and 20,000 observations.
datasets.publication_cadence: Daily and monthly data are refreshed as central banks publish changes; the policy-rate topic is generally updated weekly.

indicators.label: Central bank policy rate
indicators.unit_or_measure: Per cent per year; monthly end of period
indicators.notes: National concepts can differ; retain compilation metadata when comparing economies.

constraints: Pinned WS_CBPOL 1.0 with FREQ and REF_AREA dimensions.
Monthly end-of-period series only.
No whole-flow downloads; exact availability is checked first.
BIS does not endorse conclusions derived from its statistics.

providers.catalog_summary: Official Global SDG Indicators Database covering the UN Sustainable Development Goals with country, regional and disaggregated observations supplied by custodian agencies.
catalog_examples_not_executable: UN Data datasets outside the Global SDG Indicators Database

datasets.title: SDG 8.1.1 — annual real GDP per capita growth
datasets.description: Annual growth rate of real GDP per capita from the current official Global SDG Indicators release.
datasets.geographic_coverage: Reviewed ISO3-to-UN M49 country mappings; regions and aggregates are excluded.
datasets.temporal_coverage: Provider-dependent by country; each request is limited to 75 years, 25 pages and 20,000 observations.
datasets.publication_cadence: The Global SDG Indicators Database is published in named releases; the current series release is resolved and recorded at acquisition.
metadata_fields: bounds, base period, source and footnotes

indicators.label: Annual growth rate of real GDP per capita
indicators.notes: Nature and reporting-type variants remain distinct; the connector does not silently choose or aggregate them.

constraints: Indicator 8.1.1 and series NY_GDP_PCAP only.
Latest official release is resolved and its identifier and metadata hash are pinned to the acquisition record.
M49 mappings, pagination totals and all disaggregation/attribute fields are validated and preserved.
Test or unmarked surfaces are rejected.
